UPDATE bills SET status = 'CANCELLED', confirmation_token_hash = NULL, confirmation_token_expires_at = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND bill_id = #{billId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'RECONFIRM')

UPDATE bills SET status = 'PAID', confirmation_token_hash = NULL, confirmation_token_expires_at = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND bill_id = #{billId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
